title: Rust-TOPS Baseline v2 debt ledger
description: rust-tops-baseline.json: what one crate has over the line today (PROTOCOL.md section 16.1). Keys are sorted, one entry per line, with no line numbers; cargo tops baseline --check holds that form, which this schema does not express.

functions.description: <rel-file>::<function> to CRAP score. Only non-exempt production functions over the CRAP cap.

coverage.description: Below-floor crate and per-file coverage. Omitted when every floor is met. files keys are crate-relative slash-separated paths, sorted lexicographically, one entry per line.

lints.description: Reserved; no gate reads it in 1.5.0.

suppressions.description: Reserved; no gate reads it in 1.5.0.

exemptions.description: Reserved; no gate reads it in 1.5.0.

regressions.description: Audit records for debt that was allowed to grow.

kind.description: The ledger object the key is in: functions, coverage, or coverage.files.

from.description: The old value; null for a new entry.
